mechanism.missing_capability: Vulkan loader exposes every physical device in a single-device group (no multi-device group contains both Vega dies), so vkGetDeviceGroupPeerMemoryFeatures/peer copies are unreachable; and no external-memory handle type (opaque_fd, dma_buf, host_allocation, host_mapped_foreign) is exportable or importable for buffers or images on either die. No in-stack peer-memory mechanism exists without replacing the runtime/driver substrate.

refusal: No in-stack peer-transfer mechanism is available; the frozen ladder is refused. Any transfer arm under this campaign would have to run a substituted substrate, which the issue forbids.
